TEXT: [FI] Kousaka-senpai...

TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah?

TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT:

[FI] Lightly on those soft lips-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] !

TEXT: [FI] W-W-W-What?

TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT:
